hero.subtitle: Eco-friendly, lightweight and durable cladding for every building.

about.title: A new generation of PHOMI facade and wall panels
about.text: Flexible, eco-friendly panels that combine facade, solar and digital systems.
about.text2: A solution for modern facades, interiors and renovation projects where installation speed, low weight and durability are the key factors.
about.text3: Enables a modern building look with a simpler build process than traditional materials.

worldPresence.title: PHOMI around the world
worldPresence.subtitle: Global development of flexible facade and wall systems since 2008
worldPresence.intro1: PHOMI develops innovative flexible facade and wall claddings that combine the natural aesthetics of stone, wood, concrete and other textures with low weight, easy installation and material durability. It's a modern alternative to traditional stone cladding, ventilated facades and classic ceramic systems.
worldPresence.intro2: The material is ideal for facades, interiors, building renovations, hotels, commercial spaces and modern residential projects, where speed of execution, sustainability and aesthetics are the key factors.

growth.title: Continuous international growth
growth.text: Since the beginning of PHOMI technology development, the company has continuously expanded its presence on the international market through a distribution network in Europe, Asia and North America. Today PHOMI systems are used in China, India, Canada, Russia, Belarus, the European Union and the Balkans.

scale.title: Large-scale projects
scale.text: PHOMI and its partners deliver projects of every size — from private houses and interiors to large commercial buildings ranging from 10,000 to 200,000 m². Years of development and international presence confirm the system's quality and the trust of investors worldwide.

versatility.title: Versatility of PHOMI
versatility.text: Wall panels for facades and interiors of every type of building. Facade, solar and display panels in one system.

practical.title: Light and practical
practical.text: MCM materials are stronger than ceramic tiles or facade bricks. Weighing from 3.5 kg/m², lighter than traditional materials.

designs.title: Wide range of designs
designs.text: Over 4,000 texture, format and color variations available. Panels can be customized and made to measure, according to requirements.

resistance.title: Fire and moisture resistant
resistance.text: A high degree of resistance to fire, moisture and all weather conditions. Suitable for cladding demanding surfaces such as facades, fireplaces and pools.

eco.title: Eco-friendly
eco.text: No chemicals. 100% modified clay. 15 eco-certificates across Europe, the USA, China and Russia. Over 30 patents.

install.title: Fast and easy installation
install.text: Installation requires no additional substructure or specialized tools. Panels simply glue onto various surfaces.

becomePartner.title: Become a PARTNER
becomePartner.text: We are actively growing our distributor network in Serbia and the region.
becomePartner.text2: Join us and grow the market together with us.

catalog.intro: PHOMI offers a wide range of materials — stone, wood, brick and concrete looks, as well as solar and display panels — all in one lightweight, flexible system. Equally suited to facades and interiors, delivering a modern look with fast, easy installation.
